versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 — verified against the live service.

- Description rewritten and expanded; clearer statement of what the skill does and its scope.
- Pricing corrected to reflect the tiered model: price scales with transaction value (from $0.005 USDC), and the exact amount is always quoted in the 402 challenge.
- Payment flow detailed: x402 with facilitator verification plus a facilitator-free local EIP-3009 fallback; the agent's private key never leaves its environment.
- ed25519-signed receipts documented, with the signer's public key now referenced at /health for independent, offline verification.
- Reframed as "one oracle, two capabilities": transaction safety (/v1/guard) and counterparty trust (/v1/attestation), so integrators understand the full surface.
- Added references to the public track record (/stats) and the outcome-reporting loop (/v1/outcome).
- Data sources clarified: GoPlus token security + Alchemy eth_call simulation, reviewed by an LLM council.
- Repository slimmed to a minimal skill manifest (SKILL.md) for agent marketplaces and integration.

Initial release of sentinel-transaction-safety skill — pre-execution transaction safety oracle for autonomous AI agents.

- Agents receive a SAFE / UNSAFE / UNKNOWN safety verdict, standardized SENTINEL Score (0–100, grade AAA–D), and an ed25519-signed receipt before signing on-chain transactions.
- Evaluates contract risks (GoPlus), simulates transaction execution (Alchemy eth_call), checks for honeypots (honeypot.is), and analyzes LP concentration/rug risks.
- Pure pay-per-call billing via x402 (Base USDC, EIP-3009 authorization); requires no accounts, API keys, or SDK.
- Skill never requires private keys; payment is made via off-chain EIP-3009 signed authorization.
- No free trial: every API call requires a paid x402 authorization.
- Compatible with any agent that can POST and sign EIP-3009 on Base; requires internet access.
